hooks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$d = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $p = $d.tool_input.file_path; if ($p -match '\.github[\\/]skills[\\/]') { Write-Output 'MIRROR REMINDER: sync changes to .claude/skills/ and .cursor/skills/' }"

pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$d = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $p = $d.tool_input.file_path; if ($p -match '\.py$') { if (Get-Command ruff -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { ruff check $p } else { Write-Output 'ruff not found - skipping lint (install: pip install ruff)' } }"
